title: QCell: Recombining and Aligning Cell Queries for Overlapping Instance Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2608.29253v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Instance segmentation of overlapping cells in microscopy remains challenging due to semi-transparent structures that produce weak boundaries and mixed visual evidence in overlap regions. Existing methods address this through local regions of interest or shape priors but lack global reasoning across overlapping objects. We present QCell, a novel query-based model that de-overlaps cell instances in microscopy scenes. Our approach combines (i) an instance recombination module that decomposes and recombines query representations in latent space, enabling the model to reason about complete object structure under overlap, and (ii) a contrastive query alignment objective that combines distinctive instance feature learning and separation of overlapping cell queries. We additionally introduce a new Organoid dataset benchmark for overlapping cell segmentation. We show that QCell outperforms state-of-the-art methods across multiple benchmarks, ac

translated_title: QCell：面向重叠实例分割的细胞查询重组与对齐
translated_abstract: 显微镜图像中重叠细胞的实例分割仍然具有挑战性，原因在于半透明结构会产生微弱的边界以及重叠区域中混合的视觉证据。现有方法通过局部感兴趣区域或形状先验来解决这一问题，但缺乏对重叠对象的全局推理能力。我们提出了QCell，一种新颖的基于查询的模型，用于在显微场景中分离重叠的细胞实例。我们的方法结合了：（i）实例重组模块，在潜空间中分解并重组查询表示，使模型能够在存在重叠的情况下推理完整的对象结构；（ii）对比查询对齐目标，将独特的实例特征学习与重叠细胞查询的分离相结合。此外，我们引入了一个新的用于重叠细胞分割的类器官（Organoid）数据集基准。实验表明，QCell在多个基准上均优于最先进的方法。
tldr: 提出QCell模型，通过实例重组模块在潜空间中分解重组查询表示，并结合对比查询对齐目标实现显微图像中重叠细胞实例的有效分离，同时引入新的类器官数据集基准，性能超越现有最先进方法。
